gloss: minor collision; fender bender; contact accident

definitions.gloss: minor collision; fender bender; contact accident
definitions.explanation: A traffic accident involving light contact between vehicles, or between a vehicle and a person, bicycle, or object. Typically implies minor damage without serious injury, in contrast to a major collision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{接触事故|せっしょくじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: I had a fender bender in the parking lot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{接触事故|せっしょくじこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Minor collisions between bicycles and cars are occurring frequently.

examples.japanese: {接触事故|せっしょくじこ}であって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Surprisingly many people don't know that even a minor collision must be reported to the police.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧ ('contact; touching') and ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ ('accident'). Describes a relatively minor traffic incident where vehicles or a vehicle and person make contact, typically resulting in scratches, dents, or light damage rather than major destruction.

USAGE:
- Distinguished from ⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}{事故|じこ}→衝突事故：27048_shoutotsujiko⟧ ('collision accident'), which implies a more forceful impact
- Even minor contact accidents must be reported to police in Japan — failure to do so constitutes hit-and-run ({当|あ}て{逃|に}げ)
- Common in insurance, police, and news reporting contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接触事故|せっしょくじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause a minor collision
- {接触事故|せっしょくじこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be involved in a minor collision
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{接触事故|せっしょくじこ}: car fender bender
- {接触事故|せっしょくじこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}: report of a contact accident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{衝突事故|しょうとつじこ}→衝突事故：27048_shoutotsujiko⟧: collision accident — a more serious crash with forceful impact
- ⟦{追突事故|ついとつじこ}→追突事故：24064_tsuitotsujiko⟧: rear-end collision — specifically being hit from behind
- ⟦{物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}→物損事故：16540_bussonjiko⟧: property damage accident — focuses on material damage with no personal injury
